theme: Vibrant Family & Kids Orientated (Victoria, Australia Perks)
overview: Guidelines for transforming Go Perks into a high-energy, colorful, family-friendly membership platform ($49/year Victoria local business perks) while preserving original brand anchors (#17434C teal ink and #B9512E terra orange).

contrast_safe_text_pairings.usage: Kid-friendly callouts, discount pills, hero tags
Days Out & Fun badges, sticky promos
Water & Outdoor activities, map pin highlights
Special savings counters, verified partner badges
Family Pass highlights, VIP perk badges

playful_shapes_and_motifs.ticket_edge: CSS mask radial gradient ticket notches on cards and membership pass visual
playful_shapes_and_motifs.tactile_shadows: Hard offset border shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#17434C]) for playful toy-like depth
playful_shapes_and_motifs.sticker_badges: Rotated badges (-2deg or 3deg) with dashed/bold stroke outlines for 'Sticker' feel
playful_shapes_and_motifs.confetti_accents: SVG floating stars, squiggles, and dots around hero images and statistics
playful_shapes_and_motifs.wavy_dividers: Soft organic SVG waves separating landing page sections

rules.H2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-display font-bold text-ink

buttons.primary: bg-terra hover:bg-terra-dark text-white rounded-2xl px-6 py-3 font-bold shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#17434C] hover:translate-x-[-1px] hover:translate-y-[-1px] transition-all
buttons.secondary_vibrant: bg-[#FFD166] hover:bg-[#ffca47] text-[#17434C] rounded-2xl px-6 py-3 font-bold border-2 border-[#17434C] shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#17434C] transition-all
buttons.pill_badge: rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold border flex items-center gap-1.5

deal_cards.style: bg-white rounded-3xl border-2 border-line/80 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#C2DEDA] hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#17434C] hover:border-ink transition-all overflow-hidden group
deal_cards.badge_placement: Absolute top-3 right-3 floating sticker badge with price discount (-20%, 2-for-1)

business_portal.approach: Lighter-touch, clean professional partner workspace with playful energetic accents
business_portal.sidebar: Bg-ink text-sand with vibrant active indicator (tangerine orange #FF8531 highlight pill)
business_portal.stat_cards: Vibrant metric cards with soft category color backings (e.g. Total Redemptions in Lime #EAFCDA, Active Deals in Sunburst Yellow #FFF4CE)
business_portal.tables: Clean white cards with colorful status pills (Active = Lime, Draft = Yellow, Expired = Pink)

admin_portal.approach: High-clarity dashboard with bright family KPI cards and colorful status indicators
admin_portal.stat_grid: 4-color metric grid (Total Members: Cyan tint, Active Partners: Yellow tint, Redemptions: Lime tint, Revenue: Orange tint)
admin_portal.action_buttons: Bold pill buttons with 2px ink borders

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, category buttons, deal cards, navigation links, redemption buttons, and forms MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='deal-card-cafe-1', data-testid='join-perks-btn')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rules: Always pair dark ink text (#17434C or #0F3138) over light pastel backgrounds (#FFD166, #EAFCDA, #FFF4CE) to ensure WCAG AA compliance (> 4.5:1 ratio).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with expanded bright family CSS variables and playful utility classes (.ticket-edge, .sticker-badge, .pop-shadow).
2. Enhance main Landing Page components (Hero, CategoryTiles, DealCard, LaunchBanner, Pricing ticket) to incorporate bright family photos and vibrant color accents.
3. Apply category color mapping across DealCards and Category Filter buttons so each deal type has a distinct playful color identity.
4. Add playful sticker-style badges (-2deg tilt, hard 2px offset border) to highlight AUD $49/year pricing and member savings.
5. Update Member Dashboard, Business Portal (/business), and Admin Portal (/admin) with colorful stat cards and clear high-contrast status badges.
6. Ensure all interactive components include data-testid attributes.
